sentences.en: Ross Ulbricht had just put the last lines of his emergency list into action.
sentences.zh: 罗斯·乌布利希（Ross Ulbricht）刚刚启动了他应急清单上的最后几项措施。

sentences.en: Find place to live on Craigslist for cash and create new identity, name and backstory.
sentences.zh: 在Craigslist上用现金找个住处，并创建一个新的身份、姓名和背景故事。

sentences.en: He found a room to rent on Craigslist, paid cash and said his name was Joshua Terry.
sentences.zh: 他在Craigslist上租了一间房，付了现金，并自称是约书亚·特里（Joshua Terry）。

sentences.en: He gave his new roommates a backstory for Joshua, one that was very similar to his own.
sentences.zh: 他给新室友编造了一个关于约书亚的背景故事，这个故事与他自己的经历非常相似。

sentences.en: He ordered fake IDs for his new identity from Silk Road, but those fake IDs were intercepted by Customs and Border Protection, and they had passed them on to the Homeland Security
sentences.zh: 他通过“丝绸之路”（Silk Road）为自己的新身份订购了假证件，但这些假证件被海关及边境保卫局拦截，并转交给了国土安全部

sentences.en: Office in San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 驻旧金山办公室。

sentences.en: Now, two agents from Homeland Security were knocking on Ross's door.
sentences.zh: 现在，两名国土安全部的特工正在敲罗斯的门。

sentences.en: Ross froze when he saw the agents.
sentences.zh: 看到特工时，罗斯僵住了。

sentences.en: He thought it could only mean one thing, but he managed to compose himself and open the door.
sentences.zh: 他以为这只意味着一件事，但他还是设法让自己镇定下来并打开了门。

sentences.en: The agents asked him to step outside.
sentences.zh: 特工要求他到外面去。

sentences.en: and Ross complied.
sentences.zh: 罗斯照做了。

sentences.en: The agents showed him the fake IDs.
sentences.zh: 特工向他出示了那些假证件。

sentences.en: Ross didn't utter a word, but he couldn't hide the fear on his face.
sentences.zh: 罗斯一言不发，但他无法掩饰脸上的恐惧。

sentences.en: It was shaking.
sentences.zh: 他在发抖。

sentences.en: This was it.
sentences.zh: 就是现在了。

sentences.en: His worst fears had come true.
sentences.zh: 他最担心的事成真了。

sentences.en: It was all over.
sentences.zh: 一切都完了。

sentences.en: They demanded to see his real ID.
sentences.zh: 他们要求查看他的真实证件。

sentences.en: Ross handed it over and the agents did some checks.
sentences.zh: 罗斯交出了证件，特工进行了一些核查。

sentences.en: But nothing flagged.
sentences.zh: 但没有任何异常记录。

sentences.en: The agents could see how nervous he was and they told him to settle down.
sentences.zh: 特工看出他非常紧张，便让他冷静下来。

sentences.en: They weren't going to arrest him over a few fake IDs.
sentences.zh: 他们不会因为几张假证件就逮捕他。

sentences.en: They just wanted information.
sentences.zh: 他们只是想要一些信息。

sentences.en: Where did he get the IDs from?
sentences.zh: 他是从哪里弄到这些证件的？

sentences.en: Ross still wasn't sure what was happening.
sentences.zh: 罗斯仍然不确定发生了什么。

sentences.en: Were they trying to trick him?
sentences.zh: 他们是在试探他吗？

sentences.en: Did they know everything?
sentences.zh: 他们知道一切了吗？

sentences.en: The agents tried to put him at ease again.
sentences.zh: 特工再次试图让他放松警惕。

sentences.en: We don't want a formal statement or anything.
sentences.zh: 我们不需要正式声明之类的东西。

sentences.en: You don't have to incriminate yourself.
sentences.zh: 你不需要自证其罪。

sentences.en: Just tell us in hypotheticals how we would go about getting some of these made up.
sentences.zh: 只要假设性地告诉我们，如果我们要弄到这些证件该怎么做就行。

sentences.en: Ross started to believe they had no idea who he really was.
sentences.zh: 罗斯开始相信他们根本不知道他到底是谁。

sentences.en: He loosened up.
sentences.zh: 他放松了下来。

sentences.en: He told the agents that, hypothetically, anyone could go online to the dark web, to a place called Silk Road, and buy anything they wanted.
sentences.zh: 他告诉特工，假设的话，任何人都可以上网进入暗网，到一个叫“丝绸之路”的地方，买到他们想要的任何东西。

sentences.en: The agents had no idea what Silk Road was.
sentences.zh: 特工们根本不知道什么是“丝绸之路”。

sentences.en: They weren't on any of the task forces.
sentences.zh: 他们不在任何专案组里。

sentences.en: They weren't trying to make a case against Silk Road or the Dread Pirate Roberts.
sentences.zh: 他们并不是要针对“丝绸之路”或“恐怖海盗罗伯茨”（Dread Pirate Roberts）立案。

sentences.en: They just wanted to know about the IDs.
sentences.zh: 他们只是想了解关于证件的事情。

sentences.en: The agents believed everything checked out and asked Ross for a phone number in case they needed to get back in touch with him.
sentences.zh: 特工们认为核查没问题，并向罗斯要了一个电话号码，以备日后需要联系他。

sentences.en: He said he didn't have one but he did give them a fake email address
sentences.zh: 他说他没有电话，但他给了他们一个虚假的电子邮件地址。

sentences.en: fractalform at tourmail.com.
sentences.zh: fractalform at tourmail.com.

sentences.en: The San Francisco Homeland Security agents thanked Ross and left it at that for the time being.
sentences.zh: 旧金山国土安全部的特工感谢了罗斯，暂时就此作罢。

sentences.en: Ross shut the door and let out a huge sigh of relief.
sentences.zh: 罗斯关上门，长长地松了一口气。

sentences.en: Meanwhile July was proving to be a very busy month for Jared Der Yagian, the Homeland Security Agent in Chicago.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，对于芝加哥国土安全部特工贾里德·德·亚吉安（Jared Der Yagian）来说，七月注定是一个非常忙碌的月份。

sentences.en: On July 14, the day after the deconfliction meeting with all of the other agencies,
sentences.zh: 7月14日，也就是与其他所有机构进行冲突协调会议的第二天，

sentences.en: Jared received a call from FBI agent Chris Tarbell from the Cybercrime Division.
sentences.zh: 贾里德接到了来自网络犯罪部门的FBI特工克里斯·塔贝尔（Chris Tarbell）的电话。

sentences.en: Although Tarbell wasn't present at the deconfliction meeting, he watched Jared's presentation via video link and was impressed.
sentences.zh: 虽然塔贝尔没有参加那次冲突协调会议，但他通过视频连线观看了贾里德的演示，并留下了深刻印象。

sentences.en: Tarbell wanted to work with Jared.
sentences.zh: 塔贝尔想和贾里德合作。

sentences.en: Tarbell explained to Jared that his cybercrime team had the holy grail of the Silk Road case, Silk Road
sentences.zh: 塔贝尔向贾里德解释说，他的网络犯罪团队掌握了“丝绸之路”案件的圣杯——“丝绸之路”

sentences.en: server, but they hadn't been working on the case for that long and they weren't sure where to start looking within the files.
sentences.zh: 服务器，但他们处理这个案子的时间还不长，不确定该从文件中的哪里开始查找。

sentences.en: So they wanted Jared to fly to New York and work with them.
sentences.zh: 所以他们想让贾里德飞往纽约与他们合作。

sentences.en: Jared said he would love to, so long as he could still work on an important part of the case that he had developed.
sentences.zh: 贾里德说他很乐意，只要他还能继续处理他所开发的案件中的重要部分。

sentences.en: Jared was still working with the Silk Road seller accounts that he now had control of after identifying and arresting the original owners.
sentences.zh: 贾里德仍在处理那些“丝绸之路”的卖家账户，在确认并逮捕了原始所有者后，他现在已经控制了这些账户。

sentences.en: Jared would take over the account and start striking up conversations with both buyers and sellers.
sentences.zh: 贾里德会接管账户，并开始与买家和卖家搭讪。

sentences.en: With this method, he began talking to a volunteer moderator on Silk Road that went by the name Cirrus.
sentences.zh: 通过这种方法，他开始与“丝绸之路”上的一名志愿者版主交谈，对方的名字叫“天狼星”（Cirrus）。

sentences.en: After a few weeks of chatting,
sentences.zh: 聊了几周后，

sentences.en: Jared became friends with Cirrus and told her he wanted to send her a gift.
sentences.zh: 贾里德和“天狼星”成了朋友，并告诉她想送她一份礼物。

sentences.en: Cirrus allowed the gesture and provided an address.
sentences.zh: “天狼星”接受了这份好意，并提供了一个地址。

sentences.en: The next thing Cirrus knew, agents from Homeland Security were raiding her house in Texas.
sentences.zh: “天狼星”没想到的是，国土安全部的特工随后突袭了她在德克萨斯州的家。

sentences.en: During the raid, Jared introduced himself to Cirrus and gave her two options.
sentences.zh: 突袭期间，贾里德向“天狼星”介绍了自己，并给了她两个选择。

sentences.en: Either she'd give up her account and help the investigation, or she would be charged.
sentences.zh: 要么交出她的账户并协助调查，要么就等着被起诉。

sentences.en: Cirrus chose to give up her account.
sentences.zh: “天狼星”选择了交出账户。

sentences.en: Jared's plan was to become Cirrus.
sentences.zh: 贾里德的计划是取而代之，成为“天狼星”。

sentences.en: He interviewed her in depth, learning everything about what she did on Silk Road.
sentences.zh: 他深入采访了她，了解了她在“丝绸之路”上所做的一切。

sentences.en: When did she log on?
sentences.zh: 她什么时候登录？

sentences.zh: 她发帖的内容是什么？

sentences.zh: 贾里德买了和“天狼星”一模一样的电脑，并安装了她所有的程序。

sentences.en: He didn't want to leave anything to chance.
sentences.zh: 他不想留下任何侥幸。

sentences.en: When he felt he had everything squared away, he logged on to Silk Road and became Sirius.
sentences.zh: 当他觉得一切准备就绪后，他登录了“丝绸之路”，成为了“天狼星”。

sentences.en: Just after he logged on, Cirrus received a message from the Dread Pirate Roberts offering a paid moderator's job.
sentences.zh: 就在他登录后不久，“天狼星”收到了“恐怖海盗罗伯茨”发来的一条消息，提供了一份带薪版主的工作。

sentences.en: But before he would put her on the payroll, he required a driver's license or passport.
sentences.zh: 但在把她列入工资单之前，他要求提供驾照或护照。

sentences.en: Jared arranged a fake driver's license with a photograph of a female agent and sent the Dread Pirate Roberts the ID.
sentences.zh: 贾里德安排了一张伪造的驾照，上面贴着一名女特工的照片，并将证件发给了“恐怖海盗罗伯茨”。

sentences.en: It only took a few minutes for the Dread Pirate Roberts to respond and put Cirrus to work.
sentences.zh: “恐怖海盗罗伯茨”只用了几分钟就回复了消息，并让“天狼星”开始工作。

sentences.en: It was a huge break in the investigation.
sentences.zh: 这是调查中的一个巨大突破。

sentences.en: By August, Jared was working in the Chicago Homeland Security Office by day and working as Cirrus, the Silk Road moderator, by night, and it was at this time he was asked to fly
sentences.zh: 到了八月，贾里德白天在芝加哥国土安全部办公室工作，晚上则作为“丝绸之路”的版主“天狼星”工作。就在这时，他被要求飞往

sentences.en: to New York to assist the FBI cybercrime division.
sentences.zh: 纽约协助FBI网络犯罪部门。

sentences.zh: 当他到达纽约的FBI办公室时，特工克里斯·塔贝尔向贾里德展示了那台电脑，他们利用服务器上的文件重建了“丝绸之路”。

sentences.en: jared stared at the computer and afterwards he stared at a nearby wall that had an eight foot long piece of paper stuck on it there were ip addresses written down on the paper with

sentences.zh: 旧金山的Momi Toby's。塔贝尔解释说那是一家咖啡馆，有人曾从那里登录并

sentences.zh: “恐怖海盗罗伯茨”要么住在旧金山，要么去过那里，甚至可能现在还住在旧金山，并利用那家咖啡馆的Wi-Fi访问“丝绸之路”。

sentences.en: Although as Tarbell explained to Jared, as quoted in the book American Kingpin by Nick Dilton,
sentences.zh: 尽管正如塔贝尔向贾里德解释的那样，正如尼克·迪尔顿（Nick Bilton）在《美国大亨》（American Kingpin）一书中所引用的，

sentences.en: not much I can do with it.
sentences.zh: 我对此无能为力。

sentences.zh: 我能做什么呢？

sentences.en: Send an FBI agent into a coffee shop in San
sentences.zh: 派一名FBI特工去旧金山的一家咖啡店，

sentences.en: After this, Jared took a good look at the Silk Road offline version, or the reconstructed version that the FBI had made.

sentences.en: It was essentially a site that looked exactly like Silk Road and had everything that Silk Road
sentences.zh: 它本质上是一个看起来和“丝绸之路”一模一样的网站，拥有“丝绸之路”所拥有的一切，

sentences.zh: 当贾里德翻阅“恐怖海盗罗伯茨”的不同聊天记录时，他发现了更多他与DEA特工卡尔·福斯（Carl Force）之间的聊天记录，后者当时正伪装成“Knob”在网站上卧底。

sentences.en: Tarbell said he did feel that something was off about him.
sentences.zh: 塔贝尔说他确实觉得这个人有点不对劲。

sentences.zh: 这时，另一位访客来到了网络犯罪办公室。

sentences.zh: 加里·阿尔福德（Gary Alford），那位国税局（IRS）特工。他在冲突协调会议上没有提及他发现的关于“丝绸之路”的早期论坛帖子，这些帖子来自一个用户名叫“Altoid”的人。

sentences.en: Like Jared had, Gary also noticed the words, Mermitobies, San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 和贾里德一样，加里也注意到了“Mermitobies, San Francisco”这些字样。

sentences.zh: 他向塔贝尔询问此事，塔贝尔告诉了他和告诉贾里德一模一样的故事。

sentences.en: it.

sentences.zh: 塔贝尔对他的话表现得再冷淡不过了。
